reviews.t: It is very soft and comfortable to wear
reviews.x: This is the second brand I have tried. It is very soft and comfortable to wear. The first week of wearing it lifted on sides several times in during the night but after running it underwater and letting it dry, it's full stickyness is back! Just a tip...instead of putting the plastic back on it every day try putting it on a plate (sticky side up) and covering it with a bowl, this will allow the stickyness to that 2x's as long. reviews.t: Love it! It works
reviews.x: Love it!  It works! If anyone knows how to make these last longer than a month or two, let us know.  The stickiness wears off eventually.  After I use it overnight I wash with a pea size drop of dawn dishwashing liquid to get rid of any skin oils and then let dry.  This usually will make the pad last over a month.

reviews.t: Not enough sticking power

claims.text: Many reviewers say the pads effectively reduce or prevent chest wrinkles when worn regularly.
A common complaint is that the adhesive does not stay put or wears off quickly, sometimes within days or on the first use.
Several reviewers find the pads soft and comfortable to wear.
Some reviewers report the pads do not last long and lose stickiness after a short time despite care.
A few reviewers mention skin irritation or reactions to the adhesive.
